verdict.rationale: The SDK documents its own non-interactive ways to run agents from Python code (Runner.run_sync, Runner.run, Runner.run_streamed), and a community report confirms the SDK ships example agents. Nothing in the pack shows how to run those examples from a terminal, or how an agent would use them to check its own work. missing for 10: documented terminal/CLI instructions for running the bundled example agents, explicit headless/non-interactive execution guidance, evidence of the agent self-verification workflow, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can run the framework's example agents headlessly from a terminal so an agent can verify what it just built

citations.quote: You can run agents via the Runner class. You have 3 options: Runner.run(), Runner.run_sync(), Runner.run_streamed()
Comparing the durable Temporal version to the original OpenAI Agents SDK examples, it's really not all that different
